spar.name: Sparring with Ser Gauntley

intro.text: Go on, then. Give it everything. I'll try to survive.

win_text: He let you win. You knew it. You didn't care.

dog.name: A starving dog
dog.wound_text: Bitten by a starving dog, Ashford

looter.name: A corpse-picker
looter.wound_text: Cut by a corpse-picker at Wendmere

wolves.wound_text: Torn by a wolf in the Thornwake

alley.name: Cornered

help.attack: He has your knife arm. You still have your head.
help.flee: The hand on your arm won't let go.

alley.flee_text: The hand on his arm doesn't move.

intro.text: The wiry little man to his right moved slow, then sudden. The man to his left that he didn't get a good look at grabbed his arm.
Oh, there's no call for that, son.

barks.text: I must gently remind you that you are very tired, and we are very many.
